title_ru: Дети Атома — аудит распространения космологии разделения атома
research_question: Является ли космология Cromwell уникальной репликой одного персонажа или повторяющейся системой верований/нарратива во вселенной Fallout?

test_matrix.A: Fallout 3 dialogue: atom → universe → split → new universes
test_matrix.B: Fallout 3 terminals/holotapes: independent atom/universe creation references
test_matrix.C: Mothership Zeta: compare creation/transformation language without equating alien technology with Atom theology
test_matrix.D: Fallout 2: search for pre-existing Children of Atom or analogous atomic cosmology
test_matrix.E: Later Fallout titles: determine whether the doctrine persists, mutates or becomes localized to Fallout 3
test_matrix.F: Physics comparison: distinguish nuclear fission, quantum decoherence and many-worlds ontology

admission_rules: A single Cromwell dialogue counts as canonical doctrine but not as proof of external truth.
Two or more independent Fallout records with the same cosmological structure raise the doctrine from character belief to recurring worldbuilding motif.
A quantum many-worlds analogy cannot be converted into a claim that nuclear fission physically creates universes.
Real-world nuclear destruction must remain separated from fictional religious valuation.
Any positive result must preserve source identity and distinguish canon, analogy and hypothesis.
falsifiers: Only Cromwell ever states the doctrine and no independent Fallout record echoes it
Later Fallout canon explicitly contradicts the Children of Atom universe-splitting doctrine
The apparent physics correspondence is only terminological and has no structural analogue

scientific_boundary.nuclear_fission: nuclear transformation; not evidence of new spacetime universes
scientific_boundary.decoherence: quantum process that can be used in branching interpretations
scientific_boundary.many_worlds: interpretive framework in which branching structure is part of ontology; not a consequence uniquely caused by fission
scientific_boundary.ontology_warning: Do not identify fictional atom-sized universes with physical quantum branches without an independent physical model.

next_action: Search Fallout 3/DLC/other Fallout records for independent repetitions, then publish a source-separated recurrence matrix.
